retrievalProfile.description: A multi-paneled portrait layout featuring a central arched window and flanking vertical columns set against a bold mustard yellow border with heavy bubble-style display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition defined by a thick mustard yellow border containing a white-outlined triptych structure. The central panel is divided into a top arch and a bottom rectangle, while two tall vertical panels flank the sides, all housing warm-toned, slightly soft-focus photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Mustard yellow border framing white-outlined internal windows
Central arched window containing a close-up portrait
Flanking vertical panels containing full-torso portraits
Heavy display type positioned within a recessed notch at the top of the central frame
coreInvariants: White internal framing lines with rounded corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple subjects distributed across four distinct windows; central arch features a large-scale face, while lower and side panels show medium-scale figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central arched window and the heavy display text immediately above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down through the central arch, and then scan outward to the flanking vertical panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the thick yellow outer border and the white framing gutters.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White framing lines and internal gutters
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm sepia and amber tones within the photography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow against muted, low-contrast photographic tones.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely heavy weight with minimal counters
Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
Horizontal emphasis in the glyph proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: C and E have nearly closed apertures
H and R have thick, blocky stems with rounded corners

composition.relationshipToImage: contained in white notch above central arch

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy custom display type for the brand/name paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, geometric weight of the 70s era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a mustard yellow square frame. Inside, create a white-outlined triptych: two tall vertical side panels and a central panel split into a top arch and a bottom rectangle. Fill the panels with warm, amber-toned 1970s style portraits.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold bubble-style uppercase text in dark brown inside the white notch at the top center. Add secondary sans-serif text in dark brown along the top right margin.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border mustard yellow?
Does the central window have an arched top?
Is the display text ultra-bold and rounded?
Are the internal frames separated by white gutters?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the triptych layout is intact
Ensure the yellow border is thick and prominent
Check that the text is centered in the top notch
Confirm the photography has a warm, vintage filter
recipe.reuseFormula: Mustard yellow border + white-outlined triptych with central arch + ultra-bold bubble display type = 1970s Pop Aesthetic.
